Monte-Carlo ACF null (AFNI-style autocorrelation)

Source: R/null_factories.R
null_mc_acf.Rd

Generates null draws by simulating fields with a mixed Gaussian + monoexponential autocorrelation model. Returns a null_spec.

Usage

null_mc_acf(template, mask, smoothness, n_perm = 5000, seed = NULL)

Arguments

template

3D template carrying spatial metadata (NeuroVol, array, or anything with dim() of length 3).

mask

Logical 3D mask.

smoothness

A smoothness_acf() object, a numeric vector c(a, b, c) in millimetres, or a legacy list with a, fwhm_vox, and lambda_vox.

n_perm

Maximum number of indexed draws supported by the resulting spec.

seed

Optional random seed used to precompute per-index RNG seeds; the resulting draw(b) is deterministic and restores the caller's RNG state.

Value

A null_spec.
